BETA Close X RS Group plc has purchased 261,057 of its ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £100 million share repurchase program. These purchases occurred between June 8 and June 12, 2026, with prices ranging from 610.50 pence to 647.00 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares stand at 473,070,370, with no shares held in treasury. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 15 June 2026 RS Group plc 15 June 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 8 June 2026 to 12 June 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. Following the above purchases and cancellation of these Ordinary Shares, the Company will have 473,070,370 Ordinary Shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury. Therefore, the total number of voting rights in the Company is 473,070,370. This announcement is made in accordance with the requirements of UK Listing Rule 9.6.6.
